messages:
alex: Quick question — trying to onboard a customer using the Ruby sampleapp on an internal VM and hitting flaky 401s during token refresh. Feels like the retry behavior differs from our Go SDK. Anyone seen this?

maria: @alex can you paste the minimal repro? Is this with the refreshable token helper in sampleapp or a custom flow? :eyes:

alex: sampleapp + refresh helper. Steps: spin VM, export REDWOOD_API_KEY, run `bin/dev` from sampleapp. Intermittent 401s on long-running streams, looks like: 
```
W, [2024-11-14T09:02:33.123Z]  WARN -- : 401 Unauthorized from /v1/chat/stream (token expired)
D, [2024-11-14T09:02:33.124Z] DEBUG -- : retryable? true, attempt=1
D, [2024-11-14T09:02:33.125Z] DEBUG -- : got 401 again after refresh attempt
```

Seems the client stops retrying after the first refresh attempt. Go client does 2 refresh attempts by default which covers our slow KMS.

jenn: Hmm. Which gem version? We recently changed default backoff in 0.10.2 -> 0.11.0 rc that tightened max attempts for non-idempotent streams. Could be related. What does `client.options[:retry]` show?

alex: using 0.11.0-rc1 from local gem. Here's local config: `client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: token_provider, streaming: true)` — no explicit retry config.

sam: quick workaround: pass an explicit retry policy to allow more refresh attempts, e.g. `Redwood::RetryOptions.new(max_attempts: 4, base_interval: 0.5)` and hand it to the client. Not ideal but helps while we triage.

maria: @jenn if we tightened stream retry defaults that would explain parity drift. Can we confirm expected behavior for refreshable-token flows? We should keep stream behaviour aligned with non-stream for auth refresh attempts.

jenn: Agreed. I can prepare a tiny PR to restore the previous refresh-attempt behavior for stream endpoints and add a unit test against a fake token provider that intentionally sleeps during refresh. Will open in ~30m. Anyone willing to review quickly? :thumbsup:

alex: happy to review. I'll add a minimal repro case to the sampleapp in the PR (VM-specific notes).

sam: also please add a note in the onboarding README about 'VMs with slow metadata servers' — saved me an hour today.

ci-bot: Build failed for branch jenn/fix-stream-auth-retry (rubygems matrix). Failure: flaky integration 'stream-auth-refresh' timed out 2m. See logs: https://ci.internal/12345

jenn: Thanks CI. I'll push a small tweak to the test to be less timing-sensitive and add a retry-override fixture. cc @maria @alex

maria: For the sampleapp change, maybe include a tiny troubleshooting section: `export REDWOOD_DEBUG_RETRY=1` to dump retry attempts and `REDWOOD_TOKEN_FETCH_TIMEOUT` to simulate slow KMS during dev. That will help customers repro.

alex: added a short note in a local branch, will include in the PR. Also posting a small snippet that worked for me as an explicit workaround: 
```
provider = Proc.new { fetch_token_with_kms() }
client = Redwood::Client.new(
  api_key: provider,
  retry: { max_attempts: 4, interval: 0.5 },
  streaming: true
)
```

jenn: Perfect. I'll open PR 4123 with the codefix + sampleapp tweak + changelog entry. Thanks all.

sam: Will review once CI is green. :rocket:
